market_context: The Nasdaq-100 sank 5.61% to 25,028.98 (QQQ -5.67% to $608.45), coming within a whisker of a bear market; the Nasdaq Composite fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and turned negative for 2026, while the S&P 500 dropped 3.7% to 6,910.39 and, with the Dow, closed in a correction as the AI and semiconductor trade unwound.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-20 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Sandisk Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Memory and storage stocks led the chip rout, with Sandisk, Micron, Western Digital and Seagate all down 12% or more; TrendForce now expects NAND flash contract prices to start falling in the first quarter of 2027. An 8-for-1 split took effect after Thursday's close, but Friday's decline is from the split-adjusted $94.40 close, not a split artifact.

stocks.name: NVIDIA Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Shares had their worst day since the January 2025 DeepSeek rout and a seventh straight decline, extending a weekly losing streak not seen since 2008. Selling intensified after Reuters reported that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia — a focus the Wall Street Journal had not identified when it reported an SEC probe on Tuesday. The stock was already down more than 6% before the Reuters report, in a broad AI-chip selloff; Nvidia did not immediately comment, and an investigation is not evidence of wrongdoing.

stocks.name: Micron Technology Inc. Common Stock

stocks.name: Broadcom Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: TF International's Ming-Chi Kuo said his latest industry survey indicates Google has cut planned 2027 shipments of Broadcom-designed TPU 8i chips by about 1 million units, or roughly 20%, mostly the higher-priced 8i Max (Whalefish), and plans to increase MediaTek-designed TPU 8t shipments; details are not final, and Google has not announced a change. The stock also fell with the broader semiconductor rout.
